property_summary: Calling SetMinSum(x) on a fresh (uninitialized) contract sets MinSum to exactly x (i.e., MinSum equals the provided value), whereas the mutant that uses += can make MinSum differ from the provided value when called repeatedly or after nonzero prior MinSum.
change_summary: Change assignment to add the provided value to MinSum instead of replacing it, altering the resulting MinSum value observed after the call.
